name: Cross-Body Cable Tricep Extension
description: The cross-body cable extension uses a cable set at shoulder height on one side while the lifter stands facing away or perpendicular, extending the arm across the body in a diagonal path. The cross-body path creates a unique torque on the tricep and allows the elbow to travel through a wider arc than standard pushdowns. It is an excellent cable tricep variation for targeting the lateral and medial heads with constant tension.

execution.starting_position: Attach a single handle to a high cable on one side. Stand perpendicular to the cable or facing away from the cable on the same side. Grasp the handle with the near hand, elbow bent.
execution.setup_instructions: The arm extends diagonally across the body — the cable should pull from the side, not from above.
steps: Step 1: Begin with the elbow bent and the handle near the shoulder.
Step 2: Extend the elbow, pressing the handle diagonally across and downward.
Step 3: Hold at full extension for one second.
Step 4: Return with control to the bent position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
common_mistakes: Using the shoulder to push rather than tricep extension
safety_considerations: Keep the shoulder stable — only the elbow joint moves
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full elbow flexion to full extension.
